Grand jury finds no crime in Nolan Wells's death

A grand jury in Mississippi has found insufficient evidence of a crime in the death of Nolan Wells. The jury's report stated there was no credible evidence pointing to criminal conduct related to his death. Wells died after a boat outing with friends on July 4. No one has been indicted in connection with his death.
